jobs.max_running.name: Longest background command
jobs.max_running.description: A command the AI runs in the background is stopped after this long, and the AI is told. At most 2 hours.

show.system_hint.name: Remind the AI to use Show
show.system_hint.description: Has the AI hand over images, web pages, documents, video and audio it makes or fetches with Show, so you see them right away instead of just a path.

compaction.prepare.name: Prepare compaction early
compaction.prepare.description: When the context is nearly full, the older part is summarized in the background, so the switch happens without a wait when compaction is due. Off means compacting only once the limit is reached, as before.

net.search.exa.key.name: Exa
net.search.exa.key.description: With a key, searches use your own Exa quota; without one, the free quota.

net.search.deepseek.key.name: DeepSeek
net.search.deepseek.key.description: Needed when DeepSeek is the search provider; if unset, the key of your DeepSeek model provider is used. Charged per search.

net.search.tavily.key.name: Tavily
net.search.tavily.key.description: Needed when Tavily is the search provider.

net.search.brave.key.name: Brave Search
net.search.brave.key.description: Needed when Brave is the search provider.

net.internal_domains.name: Internal domains
net.internal_domains.description: Domains the AI never visits on behalf of others (members, people in group chats), subdomains included, whatever they resolve to and whether or not a proxy is used; the admin is not affected. For example example-corp.com.

net.search.searxng.url.name: SearXNG address
net.search.searxng.url.description: Your own SearXNG instance, for example http://127.0.0.1:8888, with the JSON format enabled. Used when SearXNG is the search provider.

net.search.source.name: Search provider
net.search.source.description: Which service AI uses to search the web. Auto tries Exa, Parallel, Firecrawl, AnySearch and You.com in turn and rests any that hit a rate limit; a chosen one is tried first, then the others. These services are outside China and receive the search terms. Pages that can't be fetched directly are fetched by Exa, Firecrawl or Parallel, which then receive the address.

memory.extract_idle.name: Wait before organizing memories
memory.extract_idle.description: Once the conversation has been quiet this long, the AI turns what is worth keeping from the new part into memories.

memory.extract_turns.name: Turns before organizing
memory.extract_turns.description: The AI organizes only after at least this many turns since the last time.

memory.extract_max_turns.name: Turns before organizing a busy chat
memory.extract_max_turns.description: When a chat never goes quiet, the AI organizes in the background once this many turns have passed since the last time, without waiting for a pause.

memory.extract_max_wait.name: Longest wait in a busy chat
memory.extract_max_wait.description: When a chat never goes quiet, the AI organizes in the background once the earliest unorganized turn is this old, without waiting for a pause.

memory.merge_every.name: How often to consolidate memories
memory.merge_every.description: After this long the AI goes over new and older memories together: drops repeats and outdated ones, and writes a summary of what it knows about you.

memory.merge_sessions.name: Chats before consolidating
memory.merge_sessions.description: Consolidate only after memories have been taken from at least this many chats since the last time.

memory.dream_keep.name: Consolidation runs to keep
memory.dream_keep.description: Keep only this many of the latest consolidation runs for each memory. Older ones go to the trash. 0 deletes each run when it ends.

core.idle_exit.name: Core idle exit
core.idle_exit.description: Minutes with no connection and no running turn before the core exits. 0 keeps it running (the default); a head starts the core again when it can't reach it.

log.level.name: Runtime log level
log.level.description: How much the runtime log records. Set debug when chasing a problem. MIYU_LOG, when set, wins for that launch.

ui.language.name: Interface language
ui.language.description: The language terminals, the web page and the command line use for you. auto follows the terminal or browser.

usage.currency.name: Currency shown first
usage.currency.description: Amounts are added up per currency, never converted. This one is listed first, the others by code. Three capital letters such as USD or CNY.

ui.startup.name: On start, open
ui.startup.description: Whether a terminal interface or the web page opens a new session or picks up the most recent one.

ui.welcomed.name: First-run guide done
ui.welcomed.description: The first-run guide is done; the terminal and web pages no longer open it.

persona.default.name: Default persona
persona.default.description: The persona new sessions use. When unset, new sessions have no persona: no character prompt, and a memory of their own.

profile.name.name: What the AI calls you
profile.name.description: How the AI addresses you, such as your name or a nickname.

profile.about.name: More about you
profile.about.description: Anything you want the AI to know about you; can be left empty. Not included in group chats on messaging platforms.

profile.preferred_reply_language.name: What language should the AI reply in
profile.preferred_reply_language.description: The language the AI replies in by default. You can ask it to switch at any time.

commands.<id>.access.name: Who can use this command
commands.<id>.access.description: Who can use this slash command: admins are the terminal admin and group admins, everyone means anyone in the chat, off means no one. When unset, the command's own setting applies, otherwise admins.

sandbox.strength.name: Sandbox strength
sandbox.strength.description: Auto uses BubbleWrap by default and falls back to Landlock when it isn't installed or can't run.

sandbox.private.enabled.name: Private folders
sandbox.private.enabled.description: When off, neither the default nor the added private folders are hidden and file tools stop asking; Miyu's own data stays hidden.

sandbox.private.add.name: Added private folders
sandbox.private.add.description: Folders commands can't read or write and file tools ask about first.

sandbox.private.remove.name: Default private folders
sandbox.private.remove.description: Folders hidden out of the box. The ones kept stay private; for the ones taken out, commands can read them and file tools stop asking. Restoring the default brings them all back.

sandbox.readonly.enabled.name: Protected paths
sandbox.readonly.enabled.description: When off, neither the default nor the added protected paths apply, and file tools stop asking before changing them; Miyu's own data stays protected.

sandbox.readonly.add.name: Added protected paths
sandbox.readonly.add.description: Files and folders file tools ask about before changing; reading is unaffected. Write ~/…, an absolute path, or a path inside the workspace such as .vscode (any level counts).

sandbox.readonly.remove.name: Default protected paths
sandbox.readonly.remove.description: Protected out of the box: .git/hooks, editor and agent settings in the workspace, shell startup files in your home folder, and so on. The ones kept stay protected; for the ones taken out, file tools stop asking. Restoring the default brings them all back.

permission.level.name: Permission level for new sessions
permission.level.description: The default permission mode new sessions start in. Changes apply to sessions opened afterwards.

permission.start_read_only.name: Start new sessions read-only
permission.start_read_only.description: When on, new sessions begin read-only. The AI can look around and plan, and you turn read-only off when files should change. A project config can only turn it on.

clicall.tools.<name>.name: Callable from scripts
clicall.tools.<name>.description: When on, the AI can also call this tool with miyu call inside a command, and the result goes to the script; when off, it can only be called directly. Unset follows how it was registered (MCP servers and script tools are callable, among built-in tools only search, fetching pages, memory search and the knowledge base tools are, extension tools are not). Tools that write or send messages stay uncallable even when on.

clicall.mcp.<id>.name: Callable from scripts: this MCP server's tools
clicall.mcp.<id>.description: When on, all of this server's tools can be called with miyu call; when off, only directly. A tool with its own setting follows that one.

sandbox.tools.<name>.name: No sandbox: this tool
sandbox.tools.<name>.description: The admin lets this tool run outside the sandbox (scripts that touch hardware or need root). The value is where the tool comes from: ~home for your own scripts, the package's id for installed packages, shell for the built-in shell; a mismatch doesn't count. A granted tool runs outside the sandbox without asking in the admin's own sessions; group chats and strangers' private chats are still refused, and so is read-only.

packages.<id>.off.name: Turn this package off for me
packages.<id>.off.description: Only for you: your sessions get none of this package's tools, skills, commands or the text it adds to the conversation, and the settings and preset pages leave it out. Others keep it.

features.<name>.name: Turn this skill, script or MCP server on
features.<name>.description: Presets that turn on what they don't list follow this switch for the skill, script or MCP server, except where a preset turns it on or off itself. Presets that leave unlisted features off ignore it.

terminal.persona.name: Shell integration session persona
terminal.persona.description: The persona for a new shell integration session. Unset follows the default persona. A shell integration session in use keeps its own.

terminal.preset.name: Shell integration session preset
terminal.preset.description: The preset for a new shell integration session. Unset follows the default preset.

terminal.idle_new_after.name: New session after idle
terminal.idle_new_after.description: After this many minutes without a message, the next one starts a new shell integration session; the old one is kept. 0 never starts a new one.

models.chat.name: Chat model
models.chat.description: The model new sessions use, written as provider/model, for example deepseek/deepseek-flash, or @pool.

models.vision.name: Vision model
models.vision.description: Looks at images for the chat model when it cannot. Written like the chat model.

models.embedding.name: Semantic model
models.embedding.description: Improves search quality for memories, knowledge bases and more.

pools.<id>.models.name: Pool members
pools.<id>.models.description: A group of models, each written as provider/model.

pools.<id>.strategy.name: Pool strategy
pools.<id>.strategy.description: Keep a session on one member, take the next member for every request, or start from the first member every time (a main model with backups used only on errors). Left out, a pool whose members are all billed per request rotates and the others pin.

pools.<id>.subagent.name: Subagents can pick it
pools.<id>.subagent.description: When on, the AI can pick this pool for a subagent in new sessions. It is listed only once it has members.

pools.lite.subagent.name: Subagents can pick it
pools.lite.subagent.description: When on, the AI can pick this pool for a subagent in new sessions. It is listed only once it has members.

pools.normal.subagent.name: Subagents can pick it
pools.normal.subagent.description: When on, the AI can pick this pool for a subagent in new sessions. It is listed only once it has members.

pools.flagship.subagent.name: Subagents can pick it
pools.flagship.subagent.description: When on, the AI can pick this pool for a subagent in new sessions. It is listed only once it has members.

pools.<id>.description.name: Description for the model
pools.<id>.description.description: One line the AI sees after the pool name when it starts a subagent. Write it in English.

providers.<id>.driver.name: Driver
providers.<id>.driver.description: How to talk to this provider. Known providers can leave it out.

providers.<id>.base_url.name: Address
providers.<id>.base_url.description: The address of this provider's API; the driver adds the path. Known providers can leave it out.

providers.<id>.key.name: Key
providers.<id>.key.description: Write { secret = "name" } (saved with miyu provider login) or { env = "VARIABLE" }. One per provider; to use several quotas together, set up several providers and put them in a pool. Without one, no auth header is sent.

providers.<id>.name.name: Display name
providers.<id>.name.description: The name people see. The id is only for referring to models; without one, the model data's name for this provider is used, then the id.

providers.<id>.catalog.name: Catalog provider
providers.<id>.catalog.description: Which provider in the model data this one is, for example deepseek for a relay that only forwards DeepSeek.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.window.name: Context window
providers.<id>.models.<model>.window.description: The context window of this model, in tokens.

providers.<id>.price_multiplier.name: Price multiplier
providers.<id>.price_multiplier.description: Prices of this provider are multiplied by it. 1 if left out. A multiplier on the model wins.

providers.<id>.local.name: Local service
providers.<id>.local.description: A model service on this machine, counted as free. Left out, it follows the address: on this machine means yes.

providers.<id>.cache.name: Cache class
providers.<id>.cache.description: How this provider bills its cache. For now it only decides how a pool without a strategy splits. Left out, it follows the driver.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.catalog.name: Catalog entry
providers.<id>.models.<model>.catalog.description: Which models.dev entry to use: <provider>/<model>. Left out, it is found by name.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.max_output.name: Max output
providers.<id>.models.<model>.max_output.description: How many tokens this model can write at most in one reply.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.inputs.name: Inputs
providers.<id>.models.<model>.inputs.description: What this model can read: text, images, PDF, audio, video.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.tools.name: Tool calls
providers.<id>.models.<model>.tools.description: Whether this model can call tools.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.reasoning.name: Reasoning levels
providers.<id>.models.<model>.reasoning.description: Which reasoning levels this model offers.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.effort.name: Default reasoning effort
providers.<id>.models.<model>.effort.description: The reasoning effort this model uses by default: one of its levels, for example high, or off where thinking can be turned off. Left out, the provider decides.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.temperatur.name: Default temperature
providers.<id>.models.<model>.temperatur.description: The temperature this model uses by default, from 0 to 2; higher gives looser answers. Left out, the provider decides. Not sent to models that do not take one.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.price_mult.name: Price multiplier
providers.<id>.models.<model>.price_mult.description: Prices of this model are multiplied by it, over the one on the provider.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.price.inpu.name: Input price
providers.<id>.models.<model>.price.inpu.description: Price per million input tokens. A written price is used whole.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.price.cach.name: Cache read price
providers.<id>.models.<model>.price.cach.description: Price per million tokens read from the cache.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.price.cach.name: Cache write price
providers.<id>.models.<model>.price.cach.description: Price per million tokens written to the cache.

providers.<id>.models.<model>.price.curr.name: Currency
providers.<id>.models.<model>.price.curr.description: Currency of the price, three capital letters such as USD or CNY. USD if left out.

models.catalog.update.name: Update the catalog
models.catalog.update.description: Fetch a newer model catalog from models.dev in the background. Off uses only the bundled and already fetched ones.

packages.source.name: Package source address
packages.source.description: Where to look up and download packages. The official source by default; any other address must serve content signed by the official key.

packages.mirrors.name: Mirrors
packages.mirrors.description: Tried in order before the source when it is slow or unreachable. Content is still checked against the signature and hashes, so a mirror can't change it.

packages.hold.name: Held packages
packages.hold.description: Packages (by id) skipped when upgrading; the installed version stays.

packages.sources.<id>.url.name: Other source address
packages.sources.<id>.url.description: The folder holding its index. Together with a key it makes a source you trust. It goes in the system config.

packages.sources.<id>.key.name: Other source key
packages.sources.<id>.key.description: The Ed25519 public key (base64) its index is signed with. An index that doesn't verify isn't taken.

models.catalog.url.name: Catalog address
models.catalog.url.description: Where to fetch the model catalog from.

models.catalog.every.name: Update every
models.catalog.every.description: Fetch again once the cached catalog is this old.

models.cooldown.rate_limited.base.name: Rate limit cooldown
models.cooldown.rate_limited.base.description: How long an endpoint rests the first time it is rate limited. It doubles each time in a row.

models.cooldown.rate_limited.max.name: Rate limit cooldown cap
models.cooldown.rate_limited.max.description: The rate limit cooldown stops doubling here, even when the provider asks for longer.

models.cooldown.retryable.base.name: Error cooldown
models.cooldown.retryable.base.description: How long an endpoint rests the first time it cannot be reached or fails on its side. It doubles each time in a row.

models.cooldown.retryable.max.name: Error cooldown cap
models.cooldown.retryable.max.description: The cooldown for these errors stops doubling here.

models.cooldown.auth.base.name: Auth failure pause
models.cooldown.auth.base.description: How long a pool model rests the first time it fails to authenticate. It doubles each time in a row.

models.cooldown.auth.max.name: Auth failure pause cap
models.cooldown.auth.max.description: The auth failure pause stops doubling here.

models.cooldown.quota.base.name: Out-of-quota pause
models.cooldown.quota.base.description: How long a pool model rests the first time it runs out of quota or credit and the provider doesn't say when it comes back. When it does say, that time is used, up to a day.

models.cooldown.quota.max.name: Out-of-quota pause cap
models.cooldown.quota.max.description: Without a stated reset time, the pause doubles each time in a row up to this.

external.bindings.<external>.name: My platform accounts
external.bindings.<external>.description: Which platform identities are you. The key is the platform identity (for example qq:10001), the value is owner. In private chats that identity is you.

said.tool-results/unattended: Needs confirmation, no one to confirm
said.tool-results/crashed: Internal error, may be partly done
said.permissions/forbidden-kb: a knowledge base document, use the knowledge base tools
said.permissions/not-in-venue: Only works in a group or private chat
said.commands/dreamed-stopped: Memory organizing stopped: {parts}; took {took}; the rest next time.
said.commands/dreamed-stopped-nothing: Memory organizing stopped after {took}; it will continue next time.
said.commands/loop-dynamic: Loop started: the AI picks when to run next · {text}
said.commands/usage/goal/set: Set a goal; edits the current one if there is one
said.commands/usage/loop/fixed: Send it at a fixed interval, such as 5m or 2h
said.commands/usage/loop/dynamic: Let the AI pick when to run next
said.extensions/capabilities/tools/summary: Add tools the AI can call
said.extensions/capabilities/widgets/summary: Show its own content on the home screen, the sidebar, the status bar and its own pages
said.extensions/capabilities/context.inject/s: Add content to what the AI sees at the start of each turn
said.extensions/capabilities/context.system/s: Put a passage at the end of the system prompt the AI sees every turn
said.extensions/capabilities/tool.guard/summa: Allow, deny or ask you before a tool runs
said.extensions/capabilities/tool.rewrite/sum: Change a tool's result after it runs
said.extensions/capabilities/events.write/sum: Append its own records to sessions
said.extensions/capabilities/packages.call/su: Call the methods other packages offer
said.extensions/capabilities/search/summary: Listed as a search provider; when chosen, it receives the search terms
said.extensions/capabilities/act_for_external: Send messages and commands for people on a chat platform
said.extensions/capabilities/network/summary: Access the network and open ports
said.extensions/capabilities/fs.write/summary: Write to specified files and folders
said.extensions/capabilities/memory.write/sum: Remember, change and forget memories; add, change and remove knowledge bases

said.persona-problems/bad_background_focus: {detail} must be [x, y], each a whole number from 0 to 100
said.persona-problems/bad_background_blur: {detail} must be a whole number from 1 to 100

said.package-problems/bad_element: {detail} must be bool, int, option, text, name, url or secret; a list's element cannot be a list

said.package-problems/bad_page_dir: {detail} must be a relative directory inside the package directory, without .. or a leading /

said.package-problems/bad_theme_file: {detail} must be a relative path inside the package directory, without .. or a leading /

said.package-problems/bad_needs: Unknown or repeated need, only images is known: {detail}
said.package-problems/bad_group: Group name is malformed, repeated, or not a shipped group: {detail}

said.package-problems/logo_too_big: {detail} is over 256 KiB or wider or taller than 512: miyu pkg pack shrinks it when packing
said.package-problems/mascot_missing: {detail} is not in the package directory
said.package-problems/theme_missing: {detail} is not in the package directory

said.package-problems/override_bad: This tool override isn't used; the shipped text applies: {detail}

said.package-problems/script_state_left: There is a state folder for the script {detail}, but no such script now; delete the folder yourself if it is no longer needed
said.package-problems/script_clashed: Script {detail} has the same name as another tool and was not registered

said.package-problems/sandbox_tool_linked: sandbox.tools.{name} grants a tool whose file is outside the places Miyu controls (it really is at {real}); not granted: a link, or a folder that is a link, can point somewhere she can change. To grant it, put the real file back in scripts/ in your home folder, or install it as a package
said.package-problems/sandbox_shell: sandbox.tools.shell grants shell: every command the AI runs goes outside the sandbox without asking
said.package-problems/skill_link_outside: This skill folder is a link to {detail} inside the data root, outside this account's own folders; skipped
said.package-problems/skill_name_mismatch: The name does not match the folder; the skill goes by the written name {detail}
said.package-problems/skill_name_from_folder: The name is missing or not 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens; the skill goes by its folder name {detail}
said.package-problems/skill_yaml_lenient: The front matter is not valid YAML; it was read again with unquoted values taken as plain text. Quote values that contain a colon
said.package-problems/skill_description_cut: The description is longer than 1024 characters; the rest was cut
said.package-problems/skill_compatibility: compatibility should be text of at most 500 characters
said.package-problems/skill_metadata: metadata should map text keys to text values (no numbers, lists or nested tables)

said.package-problems/persona_left: Left over from package {detail}, which is uninstalled
said.package-problems/preset_left: Left over from package {detail}, which is uninstalled
said.package-problems/slash_link_outside: This command template is a link to {detail} inside the data root, outside this account's own folders; skipped
said.package-problems/slash_covered: Same name as {detail}, which covers it; this one is not used

said.config/reference-header: Every Miyu setting and its default. This file is generated. Editing it has no effect.
said.config/reference-where: Write the config in config.toml in the data root.
said.config/secrets-header: Miyu's secrets: written, replaced and deleted only through Miyu. Do not share this file.
said.config/unknown-secret: {key} refers to the secret {name}, which is not set
said.config/env-not-set: {key} refers to {name}, which was not set when the core started
said.config/no-provider: {key} points at the provider {name}, which is not configured
said.config/no-pool: {key} points at the pool {name}, which is not configured
said.config/unknown-effort: {key} is {name}, which is not one of this model's levels now. Requests go out as if it were not set
said.config/temperature-unsupported: {key}: this model does not take a temperature. Requests go out as if it were not set
said.config/temperature-too-high: {key} is {got}, above this model's limit of {max}. Requests go out as if it were not set
said.config/bad-secret-name: {key} is not a valid secret name: start with a lowercase letter and use only lowercase letters, digits, - and _, up to 64 characters
said.config/bad-secret-value: The value of {key} must be quoted text, not empty
said.config/trust-header: Which project configs Miyu trusts: the repository, the exact content, and the answer.
said.config/too-big: The file is over 1 MiB and is not read
said.config/unknown-key: There is no {key}. Did you mean {suggest}?
said.config/wrong-layer: {key} belongs in {layers}. It does not count in {layer}
said.config/not-tightening: A project config can only make limits stricter. {key} is {current}, and {got} here is looser, so it does not count
said.config/private-not-shipped: {got} isn't a built-in private folder: only built-in ones can be removed
said.config/private-bad-path: {got} isn't written right: use ~/… or an absolute path
said.config/private-too-broad: {got} is your home folder or above it, so it can't be private: hidden, it would keep every command from reading its tools and settings
said.config/readonly-not-shipped: {got} isn't a built-in protected path: only built-in ones can be removed
said.config/readonly-bad-path: {got} isn't written right: use ~/…, an absolute path, or a path inside the workspace (without ..)
said.config/readonly-too-broad: {got} is your home folder or above it, so it can't be protected as a whole: every change in your home folder would need asking first
said.config/source-reserved: official is the name of the official package source; other sources can't use it
said.config/source-incomplete: package source {name} needs both url and key
said.config/source-key: the key of package source {name} isn't readable: write a base64 Ed25519 public key
said.config/expected/lines: text of at most {max} characters; line breaks allowed
said.config/expected/english: one line of English, at most {max} characters
said.config/expected/duration: a length of time from {min} to {max}, written like 30s, 10m or 1h
said.config/expected/url: an address starting with http:// or https://
said.config/expected/name: a name starting with a lowercase letter, using only lowercase letters, digits, - and _, up to 64 characters
said.config/expected/id: start with a lowercase letter and use only lowercase letters, digits, - and _, up to 32 characters
said.config/expected/long-name: 1 to 128 characters without . or control characters
said.view/error/status/404: Not found. Check the endpoint address and model name.
said.mcp/login-done: You're logged in. You can close this page and go back to Miyu.
said.mcp/login-failed: Login didn't work. Go back to Miyu to see why.
said.model/side/core/title/summary: Gives a session a short title after its first exchange.
said.model/side/memory/organize/summary: Extracts, merges and tidies memories; needs to follow a whole conversation.
